update_policy: Preserve v1 snapshot. Append new versioned snapshots with changed activity IDs/evidence and a delta log. Keep definitions/weights/denominators fixed unless the user requests a documented refinement; preserve earlier snapshots. Revoke completed credit when its evidence no longer applies. Original full milestone gates retain their original criteria.
